name: Numeric latch
description: Captures a numeric input value on a trigger pulse and holds it at the output until the next capture or reset.

inputs.name: Value
inputs.description: The numeric input value available for capture.

inputs.name: Capture
inputs.description: Pulse input. Rising edge latches the current input value to the output.

inputs.name: Reset
inputs.description: Pulse input. Rising edge resets the output to the configured default value. Dominant input.

outputs.name: Value
outputs.description: The latched numeric value. Holds the last captured value until the next capture or reset.

config.name: Default value
config.description: The value restored to the output on reset.

state.name: Previous capture state
state.description: Stores the previous state of the capture input to detect rising edges.

state.name: Previous reset state
state.description: Stores the previous state of the reset input to detect rising edges.
